messages:
Maya: Quick idea — local multiplayer night this Friday around 7pm in the common area. Planning for 3-4 players (Switch + Steam Deck + laptop). Any tips for low-lag HDMI switches, split-screen Steam configs, or Steam Deck trickery? Also who wants pizza? :pizza:
Tom: I can bring a 4-port HDMI switch (HDCP passthrough, basically zero lag). Also 2 wired Xbox pads if needed. Tell me where to park it.
Eli: For Steam Deck: use the controller remapping in Desktop mode if a game is weird with multiple controllers. Big Picture mode is nicer for local controllers too.
Eli: If anyone's using a laptop for local couch play, disable Wi-Fi and plug into ethernet for stable local lobbies.
Jules: I can do pizza — shout what you like. Poll: pepperoni or veggie? :thinking_face:
Maya: @Jules you legend. Let's do split: 2 pepperoni, 1 veggie? Anybody allergic?
Sam: I have a heavy-duty power strip + 10m extension. I can bring it and a little label tape so controllers don't wander.
Tom: Re: HDMI switch — bring some short HDMI cables too (1m) so the console area isn't a spaghetti mess.
Eli: Quick gear checklist (copy/paste):
```
- 4-port HDMI switch (Tom)
- 2x wired Xbox pads (Tom)
- Steam Deck (Eli)
- Switch (Maya)
- Laptop w/ Steam (open for volunteers)
- Power strip + extension (Sam)
- Pizza (Jules)
```
Maya: Also thinking of a tiny rotation system: 1 match each, winner stays on. Keeps things moving. Thoughts?
Tom: Works for me. Can we throw in a chill 2-player vs tournament bracket for anyone who just wants short matches?
Jules: I’ll set a pizza deadline: Fri 18:30. Kitchen-bot, can you ping 18:15 as a reminder?
Kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled — pizza decision ping at 18:15 on Friday.
Sam: Heads-up: the projector sometimes goes to sleep if idle. I’ll bring an HDMI wake script (tiny one-liner) if needed.
Maya: Perfect. I'll post a signup sheet with timeslots and a note about bringing controllers/cables. See you all Friday :tada:
